en.title: The Tidal Singularity and the Stationary Waveform
en.premise: On the ice-crusted moon Enceladus, a radio signal known as 'Dawn Radio' is received—a signal that should be physically impossible. Its source lies within an undersea ruin, submerged for tens of thousands of years. As the protagonist, a physicist, descends into the crushing depths, they discover that the signal is actually a 'tuning device' used to locally maintain the physical constants of the universe.

zh.title: 潮汐奇点与静止波形
zh.premise: 在被冰壳覆盖的卫星土卫二上，某日接收到了一段本不该存在的、违背物理常理的无线电信号——“黎明广播”。信号的源头，竟是沉没在海底数万年的遗迹。物理学家主角潜入深海，并惊觉该信号竟是用于局部维持宇宙物理常数的“调律装置”。
